mentions.h: Police Barking to Southend Walk, May 25th.
mentions.note: won the race four times between 1924 and 1939

mentions.h: 50 GLORIOUS YEARS ON THE BRIGHTON ROAD

mentions.note: won Police Barking to Southend Walk three successive times
member of Belgrave's winning walking trio with Green and Rickard
brother of George Bentley; great long-distance walker of the 30's, international in 1938
member who used the old Battersea Park track (three laps to the mile); address given as Isle of Man
leading 50k walker; selected for the Championships in Paris (1938)
